Every addition is OPTIONAL and omitted when absent, so a datasheet that acquires none of them is byte-identical to what it is today -- which is what makes the whole delta additive (004 contracts/bundle-schema-delta.md §1).
_comment3: AI-Assisted: Claude Code (model: claude-sonnet-5) - Extended for 007-loadout-display-fidelity (007 task T011): optional item_constraints[], each a footnote-style restriction against a named item. datasheet_id is NOT a field here -- identity is (owning datasheet, constraint_index), exactly as composition[] and equipment_groups[] above carry no datasheet_id of their own (display-fidelity-schema-delta.md §2.1, data-model.md §1.1).
_comment: AI-Assisted: Claude Code (model: claude-opus-5) - Authored per curated-snapshot-format.md §2.5 (task T032). Three things this schema enforces that are easy to lose: (1) ability_keys carries KEYS, never text -- summaries live in curation/abilities/<faction-id>.json and are resolved at build time, which is what keeps authored content out of the machine-written tree entirely; (2) an uncurated optional is OMITTED, never null and never a guess (FR-019, §5), so no property here is nullable; (3) costs[] is copy-indexed -- copy_index_min is the 1-based ordinal of a copy within one army counted across all squad sizes, a copy_index_min = 1 row must exist for every model_count (guarantee 7, PRC-TIER-INCOMPLETE), and model_count values are band LOWER bounds (C2/R5).
title: Curated factions/<faction-id>/datasheets/<datasheet-id>.json

name.description: Display name. A change here IS a rename (FR-015), never a removal plus an addition.

max_copies_per_army.description: OMITTED when uncurated -- never guessed. The app then reports the rule as unevaluated rather than enforcing a fabricated one (FR-019).

ability_keywords.description: Keywords only -- 'lethal hits', 'rapid fire 1'. Never rules text.

keywords.description: Sorted by (keyword, model_scope). model_scope is OMITTED when the keyword applies to the whole unit. keyword_class is OMITTED when unclassified, which is what makes an unclassified keyword's row byte-identical to what it was before classification existed (004 FR-020); two faction keywords on one datasheet is the normal shape of a chapter unit and is never an error (004 FR-017).

composition.description: Sorted by line. 004 data-model.md §1.1. ABSENT or EMPTY when the datasheet's composition did not fully resolve: FR-008 publishes a datasheet without composition rather than with a guessed count, so one unresolved line suppresses the whole datasheet's composition and raises the advisory CMP-UNRESOLVED. min_count == max_count is a FIXED count and is the majority shape -- never read it as missing data.

model_line.description: OMITTED on zero or two-or-more name matches against models[] -- never guessed.

option_groups.description: Sorted by id. 004 data-model.md §1.2. id derives from the source's own line ordinal, which is what makes an upstream relabelling surface as a RENAME rather than a removal plus an addition (004 FR-015). scope_n is present exactly when scope is per_n_models.

eligible_model_name.description: 006 data-model.md §2.1 (FR-004). The model name a scoped stem restricts the option to. OMITTED when the stem names no subset. `scope` does NOT gain a fourth member for this -- see 006 contracts/loadout-schema-delta.md §1.2.

eligible_max_count.description: 006 data-model.md §2.1 (FR-004). Independent of eligible_model_name; neither implies the other and neither is defaulted. Carried as the source states it, unchecked against the named model's composition band.

is_per_model.description: 006 data-model.md §2.1 (FR-004). OMITTED when the source does not distinguish -- never defaulted to false, which would over-grant on the majority form of the residual.

option_choices.description: Sorted by id. 004 data-model.md §1.3. A choice is a NAME plus mechanical values -- there is deliberately no description property, which is what stops this class becoming a prose channel. points_delta is OMITTED, never 0, when the points source does not price the choice (004 FR-013, guarantee 10): a consumer sees 'uncosted', never 'free'.

items.description: 006 data-model.md §1.1 (FR-005..FR-007). Sorted by (role, item_index). EVERY choice has items, including the single-item ones 004 already publishes: the redundancy is deliberate and load-bearing, because it makes the consumer's read uniform and turns guarantee 12 into an invariant a test checks on every build. A choice whose items on one side number anything other than one carries NO singular grants_/replaces_weapon_line at all.

wargear_option_state.description: OMITTED = the source was not consulted. Distinguishes a datasheet with genuinely NO options from one whose options failed to extract (004 FR-016) -- a consumer that cannot tell them apart shows an empty list for both.

equipment_groups.description: Sorted by id. 006 data-model.md §1.2 (FR-012, FR-013). One default-equipment sentence and WHO it applies to. applies_to is an explicit code rather than the presence of composition_line, because a nullable FK alone cannot tell 'covers the whole unit' from 'names a group I could not identify'. composition_line is resolved by NAME and never by ordinal.

model_name.description: Present exactly when applies_to is model_group.

composition_line.description: OMITTED on zero or two-or-more name matches against composition[] -- never guessed.

items.description: Sorted by item_index, in the source's own order.

default_equipment_state.description: 006 data-model.md §3 (FR-015, FR-016). wargear_option_state's pattern reused without variation. OMITTED = the source was not consulted, OR the datasheet's composition did not resolve, in which case no equipment attaches at all.

item_constraints.description: Sorted by constraint_index. 007 data-model.md §1.1 (FR-009). A restriction the datacard states against a NAMED ITEM, captured as its own structured fact rather than left as a marker artifact on the item's own name. Zero rows is the overwhelmingly common case. weapon_line is OMITTED unless item_name matches exactly one weapons[] row of this datasheet -- never guessed.

weapon_line.description: OMITTED on zero or two-or-more name matches against weapons[] -- never guessed.

model_name.description: Present only when the source scopes the restriction to a named model group.

leader_pairs.description: Sorted datasheet ids this datasheet may lead.

wargear_options.description: Sorted by id. COST-BEARING options only; points_delta comes from the points source while the structure comes from the detail source (C8/R3). An option whose cost the points source does not publish is the advisory CON-WARGEAR-COST-MISSING, never a zero.

costs.description: Sorted by (pricing_context, copy_index_min, model_count). At least one row is required; none is the blocking CON-NO-COST (FR-030). source_acquisition_id is CURATED-ONLY. pricing_context is ABSENT for the price the unit costs in its own army -- which is what every row here has always meant -- and present only where the points source states a condition this price applies under that the model count cannot express.

pricing_confidence.description: The datasheet-level confidence state and its carry-forward bookkeeping. 'unverified' is advisory -- the unit ships on the best price known, never withheld and never dropped (FR-035). 'unpriced' is the only pricing state that blocks (FR-026).
